literal: How much, in one way, why is it sweet, behold, love, when if they think of those whom they themselves love, that which comes is a certain joy!
translation: Behold, how sweet is love! For if one merely thinks of the beloved, it brings such an exquisite joy.
modern: நாம் விரும்பும் காதலரை நினைக்கும்போதே இன்பம் தருகிறது என்றால், காமம் எவ்வளவு இனிமையானது என்று பாருங்கள்!
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine marvels at the nature of love. She expresses that love is incredibly sweet because even the mere thought of the beloved brings immense joy. The word 'நினைப்ப' (when thinking of) highlights that physical presence is not required to experience the pleasure of love; memory alone is sufficient. The phrase 'வருவது ஒன்று' refers to the unique, incomparable happiness that arises from these thoughts.
